speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are bringing a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; to help me understand the cause, how many hours old was your baby when you first noticed this jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely secondary to insufficient intake/weight loss) or early onset pathologic jaundice; I need to review the direct and total bilirubin levels from your infant's lab results. REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound (to rule out biliary atresia if direct fraction is high).
